gloss: the nations; the powers; countries of the world

definitions.gloss: the nations; the powers; countries of the world
definitions.explanation: A collective term for the nations of the world, especially in the context of international relations or diplomacy. Often implies major or influential countries.

examples.japanese: {列国|れっこく}が{協力|きょうりょく}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
{列国|れっこく}の{代表|だいひょう}が{会議|かいぎ}に{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Representatives of the nations gathered at the conference.

examples.japanese: {幕末|ばくまつ}には{列国|れっこく}が{日本|にほん}に{開国|かいこく}を{迫|せま}った。
examples.english: At the end of the Edo period, the foreign powers pressured Japan to open its borders.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal and somewhat literary term. Often used in historical contexts to refer to Western powers ({列強|れっきょう} is a near synonym emphasizing military might). Common in discussions of international diplomacy and historical events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {列国|れっこく}の{代表|だいひょう} (representatives of the nations)
- {列国|れっこく}{間|かん}の{関係|かんけい} (relations among nations)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {列強|れっきょう}: the great powers — emphasizes military and political power, often used historically
- {諸国|しょこく}: various countries — a broader, less formal term
